exposure: Maternal risk factors for gestational diabetes (GDM)
cohort: 206,917 singleton live births born to 170,126 women aged 15-45 years in Tuscany, Italy, from 2010 to 2018
finding: Male fetal sex was associated with a higher risk of GDM, while female fetal sex amplified the excess GDM risk driven by pregestational obesity and increased the risk of LGA in pregnancies with GDM, but appeared to protect against unplanned cesarean sections in primiparous pregnancies with GDM.
